structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son, and maybe the bank. The page lists Harel's 105 products with fees and returns, but in that pile of numbers I couldn't tell which track is as safe as a deposit, and the safest-looking one, "כספי (שקלי)", seemed to give only about 4% over 3 years.

The same table over and over. I got tired and stopped.
